issues.issue: Result cites N=1096 for siponimod and N=545 for placebo denominators but the citation table header shows Siponimod (N=1099) and Placebo (N=546); the text also asserts '21.2% relative risk reduction' and '5.4% absolute risk reduction' which the raw table quote labels only as bare numbers (21.2%, 5.4%) without defining them as RRR/ARR.
